fields.topology_type: Switched point-to-point full-duplex link only (no shared medium / CSMA/CD at 800G). One 800 Gb/s MAC per port, connected through its RS/PCS/PMA/PMD to one PMD-class medium (8 parallel fibers or 2x4 CWDM wavelengths), typically inside an OSFP / QSFP-DD800 module. The PHY internally spreads the 800 Gb/s stream across multiple PCS lanes with alignment markers.

supported_topologies.name: Switched point-to-point full-duplex
supported_topologies.description: The only 800G topology; every link is collision-free.

supported_topologies.name: Pluggable-optics link
supported_topologies.description: OSFP / QSFP-DD800 module carrying one 800G channel over DR8/SR8/VR8/2xFR4.

supported_topologies.name: Breakout
supported_topologies.description: One 800G port broken out to 8x100G or 2x400G / 4x200G via the lane-granular PHY.

supported_topologies.name: AEC / AOC
supported_topologies.description: Active electrical / active optical cable for short reach.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Owns 800 Gb/s frame assembly + CRC-32; full-duplex (no carrier sense).
Bit-mux/retime + PAM4 electro-optical attachment over 8x100G or 4x200G lanes.
Clause-45 MDIO master configuring/monitoring the PMA/PMD, PCS, and AN MMDs.

fields.interconnect_role: The 800GAUI electrical lanes and the PMD fiber lanes are strictly point-to-point; there is no fan-out on the data path. The Clause-45 MDIO bus is a shared management bus addressed by PRTAD.

ordering_guarantees.in_link_ordering: MAC delivers received frames in order; the PCS recovers lane order via alignment markers.
ordering_guarantees.flow_control: PAUSE applies to all traffic on a link; PFC (802.1Qbb) is per-priority.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: No MAC-layer address space. PHY management is the Clause-45 MMD register space (PMA/PMD, PCS, AN). PHY identity is in the Clause-45 PMA/PMD identifier registers; module identity is in the CMIS module EEPROM.

device_classification.switch_ASIC_port: One 800G MAC + PHY per port; 51.2 Tb/s silicon = 64 x 800G.
device_classification.pluggable_module: OSFP / QSFP-DD800 optics implementing a DR8/SR8/VR8/2xFR4 PMD.
device_classification.NIC_DPU: 800G host adapter (MAC + PHY + PCIe / chiplet host interface).
device_classification.AEC_AOC: Active cable with retimer + PHY at each end.
